item.title: Zoonoses Best Published Papers Award 2025 - Zoonoses Journal
item.description: We are pleased to announce that six articles have been nominated for the Best Published Papers Award 2025 by the Editorial Board of Zoonoses: Decoding the WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2024: A Critical Analysis of Global and Chinese Key Data https://www.scienceopen.com/hosted-document?doi=10.15212/ZOONOSES-2024-0061 Author(s): Zhi Chen, Tao Wang, Jingli Du, Lin Sun, Guirong Wang, Ruizi Ni, Yajing An, […]

item.title: Unusual Clinical Features of Toscana Virus Central Nervous System Infections in Italy
item.description: Analysis of 35 neuroinvasive Toscana virus cases shows mostly mild meningitis with recovery, rare encephalitis needing ICU care, and rising neurotropic severity

item.title: An African Lineage Zika Virus Infecting Free-Living Neotropical Primates in Southern Brazil
item.description: ZIKV related to African strain MR766 caused neuropathology in wild Brazilian howler monkeys, implying multiple introductions and sylvatic maintenance

item.title: Enhanced Bayesian Spline Regression Approach for Modelling Trends in Infections Caused by Pathogens Commonly Transmitted Through Food
item.description: This study presents an enhanced Bayesian model that addresses key challenges by treating year as a continuous variable, incorporating an interaction between year and site, and applying splines to more accurately capture non‑linear trends.

item.title: Human Parvovirus B19 Co-infection in a Patient with Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome: A Case Report
item.description: This study reports a case of prolonged hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) complicated by parvovirus B19 co-infection.

item.title: Interpretation of the Global Tuberculosis Report 2025: Global Epidemic Trends and China’s Control Strategy
item.description: This article offers a structured interpretation of the Global Tuberculosis Report 2025, evaluating past control measures and identifying core challenges and opportunities for development.

item.title: Prevalence and Molecular Characterization of MTBC at the Human-Livestock Interface Across Five Regions of Tanzania
item.description: The findings of this study suggest ongoing circulation of Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex (MTBC) at the human–livestock interface in Tanzania, raising concerns about potential zoonotic transmission.

item.title: A High-Resolution Geospatial Framework for Zoonotic Plague Risk Mapping in Madagascar
item.description: This study mapped plague risk by integrating environmental suitability with population exposure

item.title: Isolation, Prevalence, and Antibiotic Susceptibility of Listeria monocytogenes Circulating in Smallholder Dairy Farms in Amhara Regional State, Ethiopia - Zoonoses Journal
item.description: The study highlights Listeria monocytogenes in raw milk as a significant zoonotic and public health risk.

item.title: High Seroprevalence of Hepatitis E Virus in Feral Swine ( Sus Scrofa) from Bahía Samborombón, Argentina: Relevance to One Health Surveillance
item.description: This study reports high seropositivity levels of Hepatitis E virus in Argentina’s wetlands, pointing to widespread exposure in this high‑density ecosystem.

item.title: Chapare Virus—An Emerging Hemorrhagic Fever Threat: A CBRNE Perspective on Preparedness and Biosecurity Risks
item.description: This study describes the CBRNE perspective on preparedness and biosecurity risks on the emerging threat of chapare virus- induced hemorrhagic fever.

item.title: The First Molecular Characterization of Pediatric Visceral Leishmaniasis in Jordan
item.description: A first peer-reviewed report describing the clinical and molecular aspects of the locally acquired pediatric visceral leishmaniasis cases in Jordan.

item.title: Changing Epidemiologic Characteristics of Dengue Fever in Chinese Mainland Between 2019 and 2024
item.description: This study tracks Dengue Fever shifts in China, linking earlier outbreaks and rising transmission to climate change and post-COVID travel surges.

item.title: Tick Exposure Patterns and Associated Risk Factors in Northeastern China
item.description: This study investigates the tick exposure patterns, risk of tick bites and the effectiveness of protective measures in an endemic region in northeastern China.

item.title: First Report of Clinical Toxoplasmosis in a Wild Royal Bengal tiger (Panthera tigris tigris) from South India
item.description: First report of clinical toxoplasmosis in a live wild Bengal tiger from South India, documenting diagnosis, treatment, recovery, and conservation implications.
